drift_resolved.description: The spec requires Electron main process initialization with ServiceBootstrap in packages/desktop/src/main/index.ts, but the actual main process still uses legacy SurrealDB initialization and has not been updated to use ServiceBootstrap from the infrastructure layer.

The spec requires App.tsx to be completely refactored to remove DEMO_SPACES mock data (~380 lines) and integrate with real data hooks, but the current App.tsx likely still contains mock data and hasn't been split into App/AppContent pattern with InvalidationProvider wrapper.

The spec requires comprehensive mutation hooks (useCreateSpace, useDeleteSpace, useUpdateSpace, useReorderSpaces, useCreateItem, useMoveItem, usePinItem, useUnpinItem) but only useDeleteItem and useDeleteSpace are implemented in the actual codebase.
The spec requires useSpaces hook to fetch data from SpacesFacade via serviceRegistry, but this hook is not implemented in the actual codebase, only useSpaceItems exists.
The spec requires usePinnedItems and useRecentItems hooks for specialized data fetching, but these hooks are missing from the actual implementation.
The spec requires useFormValidation hook with ValidationSchema integration, but this hook is not implemented in the actual codebase.
The spec requires Zustand UI stores (navigationUiStore, dragDropUiStore) for managing UI state, but these stores are missing from the actual implementation.
The spec requires ErrorFallback component with proper styling and GlobalErrorBoundary wrapper, but only DomainErrorBoundary is implemented without the complete error handling system.
The spec requires loading skeleton components (Skeleton, SpaceListSkeleton) for better UX during data fetching, but these components are not implemented.
The spec requires prerequisite verification that all facades from Spec 009 are complete and registered in ServiceBootstrap, but this verification step appears to be missing.
